root_cause: The native <dialog> element does not automatically focus its [autofocus] child when shown via showModal() in this test environment. Synchronous focus() calls in _showElement execute before the dialog is fully in the top layer, and microtask-scheduled focus runs after the test's synchronous assertion check. Focus remains on <body> because the dialog opens but never captures keyboard focus.
repair_strategy: In DialogBase._showElement, after calling showModal(), schedule focus on the [autofocus] element using requestAnimationFrame to ensure the dialog is rendered in the top layer, with a synchronous fallback for environments where rAF runs immediately. This matches Bootstrap's pattern for top-layer focus management.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users opening the filters drawer will land directly on the search field, enabling immediate filter interaction without a pointer.
functional_risks: Minimal timing difference in production (one frame) — negligible for user perception.
If requestAnimationFrame is not available (unlikely), synchronous focus may still race with top-layer entry, but this matches prior behavior.
verification_requirements: After opening the drawer via keyboard, focus is on #filters-search.
Pressing Space on #in-stock checkbox toggles its state.
Pressing Tab twice and Enter on #apply updates the applied output to 'in'.
Escape closes drawer and returns focus to #filters-open.
